title: lens culinaris subsp. nigricans
intro: Lens culinaris subsp. nigricans, commonly known as black lentil, is a subspecies of the lentil plant. It is a rich source of nutrients, offering numerous health benefits, including reducing the risk of heart disease, managing blood sugar levels, and providing antioxidant properties to combat oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of black lentil include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of black lentil include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable addition to traditional medicine.
